title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Lesson 14 ]

items.text: He has studied English for ten years.
alternatives: He has studied English for 10 years.
He's studied English for ten years.

items.text: I was looking for a driver.
alternatives: I was searching for a driver.

items.text: He will be doing his homework.
alternatives: He will be doing homework.

items.text: He has been looking for a clue.
alternatives: He's been looking for a clue.
He has been searching for a clue.
He has been looking for clues.

items.text: Either you or I should do it.
alternatives: Either you or I should do that.
Either you or I must do it.
Either you or I have to do it.

items.text: Neither you nor I am responsible for it.
alternatives: Neither you nor I am responsible for that.

items.text: He ran so fast that I could not keep up with him.
alternatives: He ran so fast I couldn't keep up with him.
He ran so fast that I could not follow him.
He ran so quickly that I could not keep up with him.

items.text: Three bombs exploded, one injuring 25 people.
alternatives: Three bombs exploded, one injuring twenty-five people.
Three bombs exploded, one of them injuring 25 people.
Three bombs went off, one injuring 25 people.
Three bombs exploded, one wounding 25 people.

items.text: He worked hard, hoping to pass the entrance examination.
alternatives: He studied hard, hoping to pass the entrance examination.
He worked hard, hoping to pass the entrance exam.
He studied hard, hoping to pass the entrance exam.
Hoping to pass the entrance exam, he studied hard.
He studied hard, hoping to pass the entrance test.

items.text: Three bombs exploded, killing three people.
alternatives: Three bombs exploded, killing 3 people.
Three bombs went off, killing three people.

items.text: He read the letter, tears pouring down his cheeks.
alternatives: He read the letter, tears running down his cheeks.
He read the letter, tears streaming down his cheeks.
He read the letter, tears rolling down his cheeks.
He read the letter, tears flowing down his cheeks.

items.text: He being sick, I took his place.
alternatives: He being ill, I took his place.
He being sick, I replaced him.

items.text: He escaped, afraid he would be punished.
alternatives: He escaped, fearing he would be punished.
He escaped, fearing that he would be punished.
He escaped, afraid of being punished.

items.text: Having finished the homework, I had nothing to do.
alternatives: Having finished the homework, I didn't have anything to do.
Having done the homework, I had nothing to do.
Having completed the homework, I had nothing to do.

items.text: Having finished the homework, I have nothing to do.
alternatives: Having finished the homework, I don't have anything to do.
Having completed the homework, I have nothing to do.
Having done the homework, I have nothing to do.
